answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, diluted when peers disagree. Every claim climbs the violet of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the dune re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the garden of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
